condition: Cancellation 90 days or more before the event
rule: The client loses the deposit. No other fee is due.

condition: Cancellation 60 to 89 days before the event
rule: 25% of the package fee is due.

condition: Cancellation 30 to 59 days before the event
rule: 50% of the package fee is due.

condition: Cancellation fewer than 30 days before the event
rule: 100% of the package fee is due.

condition: Cancellation by the company because the venue closes or an event outside our control occurs
rule: The client gets a full refund, or moves the event to a new date at no cost.

condition: Days before the event for a cancellation
rule: We count calendar days from the date we receive the written cancellation to the event date. The event date is not counted.

condition: Deposit at booking
rule: A deposit of 25% of the package fee is due within 7 days of the booking confirmation.

condition: Deposit at booking for a Gala Dinner
rule: A deposit of 40% of the package fee is due within 7 days of the booking confirmation.

condition: Refund of the deposit
rule: The deposit is not refundable. Only POL-CAN-05 gives a refund of the deposit.

condition: Balance of the package fee
rule: The balance is due 6 weeks before the event.

condition: Booking made less than 6 weeks before the event
rule: The full package fee is due at booking.

condition: Late payment
rule: Statutory interest under UK late payment law applies to each late invoice.

condition: Add-ons ordered after the final guest numbers
rule: Payment for the add-ons is due on the day of the order.

condition: Final guest numbers
rule: Final guest numbers are due 10 working days before the event.

condition: Final guest numbers for a Gala Dinner
rule: Final guest numbers are due 21 days before the event. This rule replaces POL-GST-01 for PKG-05.

condition: Guest numbers fall after the final numbers
rule: The invoice uses the final guest numbers. No refund is due.

condition: Guest numbers rise after the final numbers
rule: We accept more guests if the venue capacity allows it. Each extra guest costs the price per head plus 10%.

condition: Dietary needs and allergies
rule: Send the dietary needs and allergies of each guest 14 days before the event.

condition: Dietary needs sent after the deadline
rule: The caterer tries to meet them, but cannot promise a separate meal.

condition: Severe allergy of a guest
rule: The event manager speaks with the client before the event to agree a safe menu and serving plan.

condition: Guests who need step-free access
rule: Choose a venue with step-free access. The venue list shows this for each venue.

condition: Access needs sent with the final guest numbers
rule: We arrange reserved seats, hearing loops and accessible parking where the venue has them, at no cost.

condition: Assistance dogs
rule: Assistance dogs are welcome at each venue.

condition: Guest lists and contact details
rule: We delete guest data 90 days after the event.

condition: Dietary and access information of guests
rule: We delete this health information 30 days after the event.

condition: Invoices and payment records
rule: We keep them for 6 years because UK tax law requires it.
